reviews.title: Week 2: a sell-off, and the rules put to the test
reviews.headline: The S&P 500 fell 4.4% on Thu 5 Nov and the pullback rule fired on time; a week of backtests found no edge in swing, smart-money, trim or greed signals, so they stay display-only or on paper.
points: All 41 scheduled checks ran on time, within 35 seconds of each slot
New: trade log, Euro Stoxx 50 in the scan (650 companies), track record in detail, peer and Entry views, core fund (VWRP) on the Dashboard
Eight backtests: the dip reserve costs about 1% of wealth over 10 years; momentum helps, buying 20 to 30% off the high does not
Six data bugs fixed, including UK yields 100x too small and missing 1-year returns for US stocks
Waiting on Douglas: both scoring proposals, dip reserve size, trim and greed wording

reviews.title: Week 1: launch and co-pilot
reviews.headline: Market Monitor rebuilt into a reliable monitoring and research system; the Dashboard now opens with what the plan says is due this week, and a backtest found no edge in the swing rules.
points: All 22 scheduled checks ran on time, within 20 seconds of each slot
New: index scanner, track record, Trends and Reviews pages, crash watch, and a plan-this-week panel
Takeover-pinned stocks (DCC, Intertek, easyJet) are now excluded from swing setups
One-year swing backtest: +0.04R per trade vs +0.10R for random entry, so the recommendation is paper only for now
Daily research-and-build sessions start on Monday 2 November
